reason: The methane store matches the lander's methane tank, so this should start filling the separate flight tanks.
expectation: I expect methane to transfer into its flight tank; the oxygen tank will still need filling.

alternatives.reason: Filling the oxygen tank also matches the goal, but either tank seems like a reasonable place to start.

effect: The methane is now in its dedicated flight tank, leaving the oxygen tank to fill.
reaction: The separate transfer line makes the separation of the two liquids clear.
reason: The oxygen store matches the remaining flight tank, and it is the only available combination.
expectation: I expect liquid oxygen to transfer into its own tank, completing the filling goal.

effect: The oxygen is now in its separate flight tank, completing the chapter’s goal. The result also clarifies that the fuel and oxidizer meet later in the engine.
reaction: The distinction between separate storage and meeting in the engine was a useful detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filling the oxygen tank was most worthwhile because the explanation connected the separate tanks to how the engine uses their contents.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the methane tank was straightforward and predictable, though it clearly served the goal.

surprise.text: The explanation that fuel and oxidizer meet in the engine gave the separate transfer lines a clearer purpose.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: each liquid had a matching tank and dedicated connection.

continue.text: Yes. I would want to see the return and learn what the receiving lab finds in the specimens, though this chapter itself offered little decision-making.
